verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents federating an existing enterprise directory so employees can sign in with their enterprise credentials (auth0-docs-37). It lists enterprise SSO as a supported login method (auth0-docs-82), references SAML-based authentication (auth0-docs-33), and supports AD/LDAP and Google Workspace directory integration (auth0-docs-107, auth0-docs-90), with enterprise connections offered as a product tier (auth0-docs-21). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of OIDC enterprise connections, named Okta and Entra ID connection setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of workforce IdP federation.
